line_mappings.description: Supply, fabrication, and installation of Sound Attenuators manufactured from GSS/GI steel, consisting of an outer casing made from 22 Gauge GI/GSS sheet and attenuating splitters (baffles) fabricated from 26 Gauge GI/GSS frame. The splitters shall be filled with 48 kg/m³ density noncombustible Rockwool insulation, wrapped with protective tissue and enclosed with 24 Gauge perforated GI sheet. The attenuating baffles shall be 100 mm wide, as required to achieve the specified acoustic performance. Splitters shall be provided with 45° conical or semi-circular aerodynamic ends to ensure smooth airflow entry and exit, minimizing pressure drop. The complete assembly shall be provided with heavy-duty terminations, TDF flanges, and all joints sealed using 100% nonhazardous water-based duct sealant. The standard silencer length shall be 900 mm unless otherwise specified. Mode of Measurement: Surface Area = 2 × (W + H) × L.
Supply of GI sheet steel fabricated Round VCD with Body of 24G thick & Blade of 24G thick with one side flange.
